snippet: Concise initiation toward Śiva-hood: apparatus shed, worship kept, place freed. Mind-meditated path, competent initiator, freed initiate, guru-chosen route. Single-tattva making steeped in Śiva-mood; the spoken Parā-puri
text: concise initiation toward siva hood apparatus shed worship kept place freed mind meditated path competent initiator freed initiate guru chosen route single tattva making steeped in siva mood the spoken para purification per tattva svaha seal and full oblation generalized across mantras para enclosed svaha ending first ending mantra scaled count sakti powered offering purna seals the unbroken highest rite multi scriptural divinely uttered matrka pair letters singly or the condensed mantra universally lawful realization licenses shortening only the practiced identity made guru brahmayamala warrant whole pervasion inwardly no outer expanse the doubting one joins the scattered rite through sequence into identity grace uttered rule recorded across the agamas

snippet: Charter: the concise rite keeps the goal (Śiva-hood) and the worship, shedding apparatus, eve-rite, and site — concision is subtraction of means, not of end.
text: atha samksiptadiksa iyam sivatapattih ucyate this concise initiation proclaimed now aims at nothing less than siva hood junction flagged sense secure na rajo nadhivaso tra na bhuksetraparigrahah no powder mandala no eve rite no site taking the three dispensations strip the outer apparatus yatra tatra pradese tu pujayitva guruh sivam but in any place whatever the guru worships siva place is dispensed with worship is not charter the concise rite keeps the goal siva hood and the worship shedding apparatus eve rite and site concision is subtraction of means not of end what is taught here and what does it dispense with

snippet: Pastoral hinge: non-attainment is met by the concise rite itself, joined up through sequence.
text: atanmayibhutam iti thinking i have not become identical the doubt is quoted not condemned viksiptam karma sandadhat the rite lying scattered joining it up practice continues through the doubt kramat tadatmyam eti iti viksiptam vidhim acaret thinking through sequence identity is reached he performs the rite in scattered form the concise form itself is the remedy pastoral hinge non attainment is met by the concise rite itself joined up through sequence what if the practitioner has not attained identity

snippet: The mechanism: mind-meditated path, competent initiator, freed initiate, guru-chosen route — all four interior.
text: adhvanam manasa dhyatva having meditated the path with the mind interiority replaces the mandala ground diksayet tattvaparagah jananadivihinam the tattva shore goer initiates her who is freed from birth and the rest competence meets ripeness yena yenadhvana guruh by whatever path the guru proceeds verb carried from diksayet the path is the guru s to choose the mechanism mind meditated path competent initiator freed initiate guru chosen route all four interior how is initiation performed without outer apparatus

snippet: The rite's core in two acts: single-tattva making, then the Parā-sealed spoken purification.
text: kuryat sa ekatattvantam sivabhavaikabhavitah he makes it end in the single tattva steeped solely in the siva mood cf ekatattva diksa lore paramantrah tato sya iti then with the para mantra unto him marked by iti as spoken formula tattvam samsodhayami atha i purify the tattva now first person present the purification happens in the saying the rite s core in two acts single tattva making then the para sealed spoken purification what is made and with what words

snippet: Per-tattva seal-and-offering, generalizable across mantras within received bounds.
text: svaha iti pratitattvam svaha thus for each tattva the seal iterates syat suddhe purnahutim ksipet upon purification the full oblation is cast seal then offering evam mantrantaraih kuryat samastaih athava uktavat so with all other mantras too or else as told the pattern generalizes tradition bounds it per tattva seal and offering generalizable across mantras within received bounds how is each tattva sealed

snippet: Framed mantra, scaled count, śakti-powered offering — quantity serves power.

snippet: The seal: unbroken rite, multi-scriptural attestation, divine utterer.
text: tatah purna iti samsodhya ahinam uttamam idrsam then purna having purified the unbroken highest such like rite diksakarmoditam tatra tatra sastre the initiation rite taught here and there across scriptures mahesina by the great lord agency placed above the human line the seal unbroken rite multi scriptural attestation divine utterer on whose authority does this rite stand

snippet: Two lawful routes — analytic letters or synthetic seed — both universally valid.
text: pratyekam matrkayugmavarnaih tattvani sodhayet singly each with matrka pair letters the tattvas are purified the analytic route yadi va pindamantrena or else with the condensed mantra the synthetic route sarvamantresu ayam vidhih in all mantras this is the rule the alternative is universal not ad hoc two lawful routes analytic letters or synthetic seed both universally valid how are the tattvas purified one by one or at once

snippet: Concision is gated by realization: only the practiced, identity-made guru may shorten.
text: yatha yatha ca svabhyastajnanah tanmayatatmakah guruh in whatever measure the guru s knowledge is well practiced and his self made of identity with that tatha tatha kuryat samksiptam karma in that measure let him do the concise rite capacity and concision scale together na anyatha not otherwise the concise rite is forbidden to the unripe concision is gated by realization only the practiced identity made guru may shorten who may perform the concise rite

snippet: The warrant: pervasion-contemplation preserves the whole; only outer elaboration is cut.
text: sribrahmayamale ca uktam the brahmayamala says it scriptural warrant named samksipte api hi bhavayet vyaptim sarvadhvasamanyam even in the concise he contemplates the all paths common pervasion nothing is lost inwardly kimtu yage na vistarah only in the sacrifice no elaboration what is shed is outer expanse alone the warrant pervasion contemplation preserves the whole only outer elaboration is cut what keeps the concise rite complete despite shedding
